summary: SECU AI Reception app verified end-to-end. All backend endpoints (health, chat w/ guardrails, leads, auth, quiz, analytics, patch) and the key frontend flows (chat text input, quick-action modals, lead form, admin login, admin dashboard, unauth redirect) are working.
passed: GET /api/health -> status ok, db true, llm_configured true
POST /api/chat 'Hi' -> friendly reply + session_id; same session_id continues conversation
POST /api/chat Hinglish course query -> correctly answered '45 days' in Hinglish
POST /api/chat discount/jobs -> declines/redirects without inventing info
Prompt injection -> system prompt and keys NOT leaked
POST /api/leads valid -> stored with source=AI Reception status=New
GET /api/leads & /api/analytics without token -> 401; with admin token -> 200
POST /api/auth/login admin creds -> JWT token; wrong password -> 401
GET /api/quiz -> 5 questions returned without answer keys
PATCH /api/leads/{id} -> admin can update status; 401 without token
Reception UI: text-input + send-text-button -> user bubble + SECU reply rendered
Quick action buttons open Courses and Lead modals; Lead form submit shows success toast
Login redirects to /admin; dashboard shows 4 stat-cards, course interest chart, leads table, CSV button
notes: Voice (Web Speech API) not tested in headless; text fallback validated instead per instructions. Quiz endpoint uses integer question_id (schema correctly typed).
